title: Create a matrix
prompt: Run a small test suite across several operating systems or runtime versions.
objective: Demonstrate the behavior of create a matrix and capture verifiable evidence.

starter.code:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests

expected_output: A reviewed workflow or design note satisfying: strategy:, matrix:, runs-on:, ${{ matrix.. Verify behavior on a disposable repository where execution is required; a static sketch is not proof of a live deployment.
